## MSL AI Systems — 03 Weekly Cross-Channel ROAS & Executive Digest
**Autonomy Level:** L2 (Deterministic Multi-Platform Ad Aggregation + Isolated AI Executive Summary)

### How to Demo Live on Screen-Share / Loom:
1. Click the orange **Execute workflow** button at the bottom.
2. Node `00` pulls sample weekly Google Ads & Meta Ads performance metrics, calculates blended ROAS and CPA, updates the Looker Studio & Google Sheets master rows, and drafts the plain-English Executive Digest for Gmail & Slack.
3. Every node runs 100% green out of the box with zero `$env` errors.
